title: Saturday, 8:15 AM. Soccer.
caption:
Same kid. Same shoes. Very different morning. ⚽

On game day everything is obvious: the uniform is out, the snack is by the door, the car is the cue. Monday has none of that.

A clear step beats a reminder. Comment “same” if your game-day kid turns into a different person on Monday 👇
